findings.finding: The 2026-09-24 registered-direct buyers (1,519,608 shares and pre-funded warrants at $2.04, about twice the 798,390 shares outstanding on 09-14) are 44% under water at $1.15 and hold freely tradable stock; that seller has no end date and keeps supplying into the next session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: This is not a dated event. The stock is freely tradable from the 2026-09-25 closing and has no lock-up (the 90-day lock-up binds only officers and directors), so it can be sold in the 2026-10-06 session. Under the window rule it is an inference about continuing supply, not a dated catalyst.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the RD priced on 2026-09-24 the stock fell -29.46% on 09-25. Since then, comparable falls on 09-30, 10-01 and 10-02 were followed by -14.02%, -14.18% and -4.96% (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: The price holds what has already been sold, not how much of the RD block is left. Turnover today is $174k, about 150k shares, against roughly 1.5M RD shares. If the block were spent, volume would have dried up and the stock would stop making new lows. Instead pos_52w is 0.0 and it is still falling.
findings.independence: Going-concern language in the 2026-08-28 filings (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1506983/000149315226040600/ex99-1.htm) and the 43.4M-share resale S-1 point the same way. Both are the same issuer's documents.
